summary: Added unsigned, width, precision, scale, zerofill, charset and collation (copied from the parent primary column) to the ancestor/descendant column options in ClosureJunctionEntityMetadataBuilder. The mysql test file reported 3 passing, but the mysql connection is skip:true in ormconfig.json and no MySQL server is available, so createTestingConnections returned no connections and the assertions ran over an empty array — the tests passed vacuously and did not exercise the change. As a separate non-test check, I ran an ad-hoc script (/tmp/chk/chk.ts) building metadata with in-memory sqlite for the Foo2/Foo3 test entities; it showed the closure columns now carry unsigned/width/precision/scale/zerofill and charset/collation from the parent PK. The first attempt of that script failed (could not resolve reflect-metadata from /tmp) and succeeded after fixing the import path.
